'''Arvakke''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Arvakke was a business rival of the financier [[Veilred Jydor]] and after Jydor offered a rare [[Tchine]] statue as a prize for a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament that was to be held in the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]], Arvakke sent the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Phramp]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mensant]] to rig the tournament.
